changelog: `src/lib/ai/aiFallback.ts` (517 lines) splits five ways along its real seams: the Cloudflare LoRA and Gemini HTTP clients to `engines.ts`, the shared `GenerateOptions`/`AIResponse`/`AnswerGrounding` types to `types.ts`, the grounded scoring and engine budgets to `scoring.ts`, and the self-consistency sampler to `selfConsistency.ts`, while `index.ts` keeps the arbitration flow and re-exports the same public API. Import path unchanged, so no caller changed. Previous release: the agent fast path's bilingual copy table and its rule chain split into `copy.ts` and `matching.ts`.
